disclaimers.text: MHS conformance is a behavioural test result, not a safety certification. MHS.SAFETY.NOT_CERTIFIED: MHS is not a safety-rated channel; an independent hardware emergency stop is required.
OpenMHS is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, and not a reimplementation or compatible dialect of Anthropic's MHS research preview.
Simulation conformance does not establish equivalence to the physical device; see the fidelity gaps in the device manifest.
Self-issued report (issuer.kind self): it records the subject's own run of the suite; recompute it with 'python -m mhs.conformance verify'.
